last.verdict: Cloud growth doubled, but record spending and negative cash flow spooked investors.

reasons.label: Cash burn
reasons.text: Free cash flow was negative $9.1 billion as spending outran cash from operations.

reasons.label: Huge AI spending
reasons.text: Capex reached $51.4 billion for the quarter, more than double last year's $24.0 billion.

reasons.label: Rising costs
reasons.text: Research costs rose 36% and borrowing costs climbed; debt more than doubled to $125 billion this year.

story: Cloud growth has accelerated each quarter, from 63% in Q1 to 82% in Q2 to 103% now. Spending guidance keeps rising too. The stock jumped about 10% after Q1, then fell about 7% after Q2 on higher spending.
